text:
Gentle run or not, we are grateful for your clear note and we are treating this as a service recovery matter without delay. Your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal during transfer, the strain caused by the departure disruption, and the lack of timely reassurance from our ground team.

We take that sequence seriously. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is tasked with keeping each animal movement orderly, calm, and traceable, and any break in that chain must be examined at once. I am opening a review with the station supervisor, the ramp lead, and the desk lead so we can reconstruct the handoff, confirm where communication slipped, and determine whether the carrier was moved in line with procedure. If there was any mishandling, we will document it and escalate it through the proper claims path without making you repeat the story to several desks.

<<FACT F119>>

For the departure disruption, I am also flagging the service record for compensation review and operational follow-up. <<FACT F109>> Our aim is to move this from complaint to resolution fast, with the paperwork aligned and the responsible teams briefed. If your animal showed signs of distress, please include that in your reply so the welfare report can be completed in full, and if a veterinary check was needed, keep the supporting notes ready for the claims file. We are also asking the station team to reinforce carrier checks, calm handling, and direct passenger updates before the next release window.

We understand that trust is earned on the floor, not in a promise, and we are acting on that standard now. You should receive a direct update after the internal review is complete, and the desk will continue to monitor the case until the operational record is closed out properly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
